notes: Transaction types of purchasing (ST_TRNS_TYPE + posting lines STACLNK): legacy block WHERE (purchasing kinds, group rights), code range / duplicate, effect and kind of this screen, linked types / stores / accounting transactions from their lists, delete refused while transactions exist, copy button, last serial (APP_RULES3_PR). Wave 3b: radio groups EFFECT / JOIN_TYPE / POST_TYPE and the kind list as real lists, NO_COST check box, legacy LOVs (store, GL / AR / AP / cash / bank transactions, linked types, accounts, cost centres), STACLNK debit/credit and cost-centre-1 indicator lists.

rules.where: ((TRNS_TYPE IN (1, 3, 12, 9, 13, 14, 15, 25, 5) AND EFFECT IN (3, 7)) OR (TRNS_TYPE = 1 AND EFFECT = 1)) AND (NVL(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER, 0) = 0 OR TRNS_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT TP.TRNS_TYPE_CODE FROM ST_TRNSTYPE_PASSWORD TP WHERE TP.FLAG = 1 AND TP.PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))

validations.name: نوع الحركة: الرقم والتأثير والنوع والحركات المرتبطة
validations.plsql: return app_rules3_pr.trns_type_check(p_form => 'ST_TRNS_TYPE', p_request => :REQUEST, p_rowid => :PAGE_ROWID, p_code => :PAGE_TRNS_TYPE_CODE, p_effect => :PAGE_EFFECT, p_trns_type => :PAGE_TRNS_TYPE, p_store => :PAGE_STORE_CODE, p_join => :PAGE_JOIN_TYPE, p_post => :PAGE_POST_TYPE, p_entry => :PAGE_ENTRY_TYPE, p_cust => :PAGE_CUSTOMER_TRNS_CODE, p_cust_pay => null, p_supp => :PAGE_SUPPLIER_TRNS_CODE, p_supp_pay => null, p_rp => :PAGE_RP_TRNS_TYPE_CODE, p_pc => :PAGE_PC_TRNS_TYPE_CODE, p_pr => :PAGE_PR_TRNS_TYPE, p_pu => :PAGE_PU_TRNS_TYPE, p_quot => :PAGE_QUOT_TRNS_TYPE, p_supp_disc => :PAGE_SUPP_DISC_TRNS_TYPE, p_ctgry => :PAGE_CTGRY_CODE);

info.name: LAST
info.sql: select nvl(max(trns_serial), 0) from st_trns_mast where trns_type_code = :PAGE_TRNS_TYPE_CODE and nvl(delete_flag, 0) = 0

ST_TRNS_TYPE.STORE_CODE.lov: select store_code || ' - ' || name_a d, store_code r from st_store where store_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or store_code in (select sp.store_code from st_store_password sp where sp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

ST_TRNS_TYPE.ENTRY_TYPE.lov: select entry_type || ' - ' || max(entry_desc) d, entry_type r from ac_trn_codes where nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or :G_COMPANY_CODE is null or (entry_year, entry_type) in (select p1.entry_year, p1.entry_type from ac_password_entry p1 where p1.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p1.company_code = :G_COMPANY_CODE) group by entry_type order by 2

ST_TRNS_TYPE.CUSTOMER_TRNS_CODE.lov: select id || ' - ' || description_a d, id r from ar_trnstype where effect = decode(:PAGE_EFFECT, 1, 1, 3, 0) and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or id in (select trns_id from ar_trnstype_password where flag = 1 and password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

ST_TRNS_TYPE.SUPPLIER_TRNS_CODE.lov: select id || ' - ' || description_a d, id r from vn_trnstype where effect = decode(:PAGE_EFFECT, 1, 1, 3, 0) and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or id in (select trns_id from vn_trnstype_password where flag = 1 and password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

ST_TRNS_TYPE.SUPP_DISC_TRNS_TYPE.lov: select id || ' - ' || description_a d, id r from vn_trnstype where effect = 0 and trns_type = 4 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or id in (select trns_id from vn_trnstype_password where flag = 1 and password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

ST_TRNS_TYPE.PR_TRNS_TYPE.lov: select trns_type_code || ' - ' || desc_a d, trns_type_code r from st_trns_type where effect = 7 and trns_type = 14 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or trns_type_code in (select tp.trns_type_code from st_trnstype_password tp where tp.flag = 1 and tp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

ST_TRNS_TYPE.PU_TRNS_TYPE.lov: select trns_type_code || ' - ' || desc_a d, trns_type_code r from st_trns_type where effect = 1 and trns_type = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or trns_type_code in (select tp.trns_type_code from st_trnstype_password tp where tp.flag = 1 and tp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

ST_TRNS_TYPE.QUOT_TRNS_TYPE.lov: select trns_type_code || ' - ' || desc_a d, trns_type_code r from st_trns_type where effect = 7 and trns_type = 25 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or trns_type_code in (select tp.trns_type_code from st_trnstype_password tp where tp.flag = 1 and tp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

ST_TRNS_TYPE.RP_TRNS_TYPE_CODE.lov: select trns_type_code || ' - ' || desc_a d, trns_type_code r from rp_trns_type where nvl(stop_flag, 0) = 0 and trns_type = decode(:PAGE_TRNS_TYPE, 1, 1, 3, 2) and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or trns_type_code in (select trns_type_code from rap_trns_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

ST_TRNS_TYPE.PC_TRNS_TYPE_CODE.lov: select trns_type_code || ' - ' || desc_a d, trns_type_code r from check_trns_type where nvl(stop_flag, 0) = 0 and trns_type = decode(:PAGE_TRNS_TYPE, 1, 1, 3, 2) and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or trns_type_code in (select trns_type_code from check_trns_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

STACLNK.ACCOUNT_NO.lov: select account_number || ' - ' || account_name d, account_number r from ac_master where account_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or :G_COMPANY_CODE is null or account_number in (select p.account_number from ac_password_master p where p.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p.company_code = :G_COMPANY_CODE)) order by account_number

STACLNK.COST_NO.lov: select cost_code || ' - ' || cost_desc d, cost_code r from ac_cost_centers where cost_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or :G_COMPANY_CODE is null or cost_code in (select p.cost_code from ac_password_cost1 p where p.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p.company_code = :G_COMPANY_CODE)) order by 2

STACLNK.COST_NO2.lov: select cost_code || ' - ' || cost_desc d, cost_code r from ac_cost_centers2 where cost_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or :G_COMPANY_CODE is null or cost_code in (select p.cost_code from ac_password_cost2 p where p.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p.company_code = :G_COMPANY_CODE)) order by 2
